guidance: Teach ONE specific, actionable tactic they can do this week to make more money. Real steps, scripts, or settings — worth paying for.
evidence_note: Tactics must be logically airtight and actually executable as described.
reason: Balancing the mix: 'Education / Informative' was the most under-served eligible category (target 15%, recent 10%).
post_rationale: Reels still win reach for cold-audience teaching content. This teaches an unclaimed, specific angle: the copy mistakes that kill missed-call text-back reply rates, grounded in industry guidance that carrier spam filters flag automated-sounding messages with links, promotional language, and excessive punctuation, and that a recipient who senses automation in the first message is less likely to reply. Distinct from the prior general copy-framework carousel.
